name: Algenus Kenrith
description: The twins' father and High King of Eldraine, abducted by Oko and Garruk, killed and restored, and later killed by Phyrexian invaders.

description_citations.text: "Will Kenrith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Questing Beast chooses Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest; Algenus becomes High King.
timeline.quote: the Questing Beast chose the humble Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest for the high rulership

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko abducts the High King and turns him into a stag, and the courts struggle to coordinate against the Wilds.
timeline.quote: After the High King was abducted by Oko , the fey, around 4561 AR and turned into a stag

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The royal twins find their father but their shared planeswalker spark ignites and sends them across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: the Kenrith twins' shared Planeswalker's spark ignited, sending them across the Blind Eternities to a new plane.

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ardenvale falls to the Phyrexian invaders; Algenus and Linden are killed in its defense.

timeline.summary: The Questing Beast chooses Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest for the high rulership.
timeline.quote: the Questing Beast chose the humble Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest for the high rulership and gave each a sword as the mark of its favor

timeline.summary: Algenus completes the High Quest and becomes High King.

timeline.summary: Oko abducts the High King and turns him into a stag, around 4561 AR.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Algenus is returned to life with his magical sword, and the twins' planeswalker spark ignites, sending them to a new plane.
timeline.quote: Learning the truth of their past, the Kenrith twins' shared Planeswalker's spark ignited, sending them across the Blind Eternities to a new plane.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will are born to a witch who kills the newborns for their blood; Linden gives up her sword's power to restore them and adopts them.
timeline.quote: their adoptive mother gave up her sword's power to restore life to the twins and took them in as her children

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The twins quest for their father, abducted by Oko and Garruk and transformed into a stag.
timeline.quote: he has been transformed into a stag

timeline.summary: The Wild Hunt kills the stag, and Linden restores Algenus with his Questing Sword.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers Oko and Garruk Wildspeaker kidnap High King Algenus Kenrith, disrupting Eldraine's status quo.
timeline.quote: The status quo is disrupted when the planeswalkers Oko and Garruk Wildspeaker kidnap High King Algenus Kenrith .

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The twins Rowan and Will Kenrith embark on a quest to save their father.

timeline.summary: The king is saved, Garruk is freed from his curse, and the twins' spark ignites.

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: High King Algenus prepares to leave on the Grand Procession.
timeline.quote: High King Algenus Kenrith is about to leave on the Grand Procession, his first-harvests tour of all five courts of the Realm.

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Harvest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko transforms Elowen into an eagle and traps the party in a thorn ring; Rowan realizes the stag is her father.
timeline.quote: So Oko changes Elowen into a crested eagle, which flies away, and traps the remaining company in a faerie ring of thorns and nettles.

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Wild Hunt a figure looking like Queen Ayara mortally wounds the stag with an arrow.
timeline.quote: A brawl ensues, which ends with a person looking like Queen Ayara shooting the stag with an arrow and mortally wounding it.

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The dying stag transforms back into Algenus Kenrith.
timeline.quote: As it dies, it transforms back into the form of Algenus Kenrith.

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Linden reveals the witch fed Algenus a love potion, and Algenus killed her.

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Linden uses the sword's life to return Algenus to the living; Rowan's spark ignites and she and Will vanish.
timeline.quote: As there is still life in Algenus' sword from the well, Linden uses it to return him to the world of the living.

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
